newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn values weak, soy firm.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn values weak, soy firm.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn basis offers were slightly weaker for nearby positions, while grain dealers said soybean basis offers had a firm tone.
No reason was given for the weak corn values.
Demand for soybeans increased slightly in the U.S. Gulf CIF markets late Tuesday, which kept a firm tone on FOB offers, they said.

Winter wheat values were mostly unchanged in quiet business. Results were awaited on Iraq's tender for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat under the recent United Nations food-for-oil deal. The wheat is for July shipment.
